exact_question: Approve the existing product glossary or list exact replacement terms.
options: Approve current glossary | Supply exact amendments
impact: Avoid inconsistent labels; no new functionality.

exact_question: Accept the current section baseline with named exceptions, or provide itemized original-agreement discrepancies.
options: Accept with exceptions | Provide itemized discrepancies
impact: Prevents reopening delivered work and assuming unsigned additions.

exact_question: Which exclusions and later changes have written commercial approval?
options: Approve current inclusions/exclusions | Attach approved variations

exact_question: Confirm least-privilege admin, staff/therapist and client responsibilities, including who can view names/contact details.
options: Approve existing policy | Supply specific role changes
impact: Access/privacy responsibility; broader permissions need separate approval.

exact_question: Approve Teen/Child duration for single/monthly plans and confirm the cancellation/refund/package-credit rules.
impact: R01 remains held. Reconcile slots/CMS/templates only after approval. 48-hour cancellation copy and credit restoration require policy confirmation.
scope: Original scope correctness; no assumed restoration rule

exact_question: Who owns and pays for each Google, Paystack, Resend, Supabase, Vercel and monitoring/backup account?
impact: Billing, renewal and revocation must have named owners.

exact_question: Approve retention/deletion periods and responsible policy owner for clinical/client/intake/payment records.
options: Approve documented schedule | Supply revised schedule
impact: No deletion/retention automation activated without approval.

exact_question: Approve final acceptance criteria, exception list and support success measures.
options: Approve bounded closeout criteria | Specify measurable exceptions
impact: Defines completion; does not add indefinite support.

exact_question: Accept existing responsive design or identify reproducible deviations from the approved design.
options: Accept prior visual UAT | List specific baseline deviations
impact: A new booking redesign/photo selector is a separate request.

exact_question: Which verified Zoho mailbox receives each enquiry/operational notification?
options: Confirm configured mailbox and recipient map | Supply approved replacements
impact: No new test mail or recipient change is made here.

exact_question: Provide redacted Resend sending-domain verification or identify the DNS owner who must complete it.
options: Supply existing verification | Assign DNS/provider action
impact: Sender activation requires external account evidence, not code rebuild.

exact_question: For each legacy inventory record, should it be kept, excluded or revised?
impact: 100 pending decisions are editorial governance, not 100 demonstrated production failures.

exact_question: Which specific imported facts/copy are incorrect, beyond the identified duration and currency issues?
options: Accept reviewed copy | List record-specific correction and reason
impact: Avoid bulk rewriting or treating all imported posts as defective.

exact_question: Approve the migrated content and redirects with explicit outstanding exceptions.
options: Accept approved inventory | Return named exceptions
impact: Publication is not a recorded approval.

exact_question: Which existing UAT approval covers the final revision, and what exceptions remain?
options: Record prior approval/revision | Run only missing isolated cases
impact: No automatic demand to repeat the complete suite or obtain new screenshots.

exact_question: Is the delivered public production content approved, subject to the known exceptions?
options: Accept delivered content | Identify exact production correction
impact: Do not infer an empty database from a stale unchecked marker.

exact_question: Approve final handover exceptions and the maintenance start/end dates.
options: Accept with stated exceptions and dates | Defer for named blocking obligation
impact: Defines the contractual handover/support boundary; does not promise perpetual maintenance.

exact_question: Approve the active staff/therapist access roster and assign the recurring reviewer.
options: Approve reviewed roster | List accounts requiring separate authorized change
impact: No account or role mutation during this milestone.
